subject: English
passage: Restaurants are offering customers more flexible dining options than ever before. Whether ordering takeout, using delivery services, or dining in outdoor spaces, customers can choose how and where they want to enjoy their meals based on their preferences and circumstances. In turn, restaurants benefit as well: research indicates that customers are willing to spend more when they have multiple dining options and are more likely to become repeat customers. However, it can be challenging for restaurants to maintain these various service models simultaneously, as each option requires different staffing, equipment, and operational procedures that can increase overall costs.
prompt: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

choices.A: It introduces a trend in restaurant services and then explains how the trend both benefits and poses a challenge to restaurants.
choices.B: It examines several groundbreaking developments in restaurant technology and then proposes some future implementations of those developments.
choices.C: It details a restaurant's remarkable growth with new services and then identifies various reasons that may have led to that growth.
choices.D: It compares two opposing customer service strategies and then provides illustrations of one of those strategies.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it presents the best description of the overall structure of the text. The text begins by stating that restaurants are increasingly offering customers flexible dining options, allowing them to choose from takeout, delivery, and outdoor dining based on their preferences. The text then indicates that although this trend benefits restaurants because customers are willing to spend more and become repeat customers when offered multiple options, it also poses a challenge because maintaining various service models requires different staffing, equipment, and procedures that can increase costs. Thus, the text first introduces a trend in restaurant services and then explains how the trend both benefits and poses a challenge to restaurants.
